mapper.select: SELECT relative_directory FROM thread_instruction_scopes WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY (length(relative_directory) - length(replace(relative_directory, '/', ''))) ASC, relative_directory ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO thread_instruction_scopes(thread_id, relative_directory, discovered_at) SELECT #{threadId}, #{relativeDirectory}, #{discoveredAt} WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM thread_instruction_scopes WHERE thread_id = #{threadId}) < 256 ON CONFLICT(thread_id, relative_directory) DO NOTHING
